title: Free pilot live before the paid series
question: Free pilot live before the paid series

frame.problem: We had no proof that people would attend. Do we run a free pilot live before opening sales of the paid series?

vars.name: Learning before spending
vars.ctx: A pilot tests the topic, the host and the funnel before production money is spent.

vars.name: Time to revenue
vars.ctx: A pilot delays the first sale by about 2 weeks.

vars.name: Audience building
vars.ctx: Every pilot sign-up joins the list for the launch.

opts.name: Free pilot live
opts.desc: One free live, then open sales.
